s01: Hello, my friend! (pause) Yesterday we played Simon Says. (pause) We asked who, what and where about Katkat. (pause) Today we answer WHO. (pause) Words for people are naming words! (pause) Come and meet my family!
fam1: Who is in my family? Let us see! (pause) A naming word tells who a person is. (pause) Tap each picture. (pause) Say the word with me!
fam1-1: Mom. (pause) Nanay. (pause) My mom cares for our family.
fam1-2: Dad. (pause) Tatay. (pause) My dad keeps us safe.
fam1-3: Older sister. (pause) Ate. (pause) She helps me every day.
fam1-4: Older brother. (pause) Kuya. (pause) He plays with me.
fam2: My family is big! There are more people to meet. (pause) Here are three more family words. (pause) Tap each one. (pause) Say it with me!
fam2-1: Grandma. (pause) Lola. (pause) She is the mother of my mom or dad.
fam2-2: Grandpa. (pause) Lolo. (pause) He is the father of my mom or dad.
fam2-3: Youngest child. (pause) Bunso. (pause) He is the baby of our family!
find: You met my whole family! Can you find them? (pause) Listen to the naming word. (pause) Tap the right person!
find-q1: Where is the older brother? (pause) Tap Kuya!
find-q1-yes: Yes! Kuya is my older brother.
song: You know all the family words. Now let us sing them! (pause) Let us sing to the tune of Leron-Leron Sinta. (pause) Listen first. (pause) Then tap a line and sing!
song-2: Older sister and brother, always happy!
song-4: That is why we all eat together!
s1: The song says we eat together. Let us see my family at dinner! (pause) Story time! (pause) It is dinner time at my house. (pause) Mom cooks yummy adobo. (pause) Dad and Kuya set the table.
s2: Everyone comes to the table. But wait! (pause) Grandma sits down. (pause) Ate and Bunso sit down. (pause) But one chair is empty! (pause) Where is Grandpa? asks Ate.
mid: Hmm. Somebody is missing. (pause) Quick question! (pause) Remember, who is for a person.
mid-q1: Who is not at the table?
mid-q1-yes: Yes! Grandpa is missing. (pause) Where can he be?
s3: Let us find Grandpa! (pause) Bunso looks in the living room. (pause) There is Grandpa! (pause) He is asleep in his big chair. (pause) Bunso hugs him. (pause) Lolo, it is time to eat!
s4: Grandpa wakes up with a smile. (pause) Grandpa laughs and comes to the table. (pause) Now we all eat together! (pause) We sing our family song. (pause) A family helps each other.
story-check: That is the end of the story. Let us answer WHO questions! (pause) Let us think about the story. (pause) Listen to each question.
story-check-q1-yes: Yes! Bunso, the youngest child, found Grandpa.
common: Every person has two kinds of naming words. (pause) Mom, dad, sister, brother. (pause) These are common names. (pause) Many people are called mom! (pause) We write them with small letters.
special: Mom is a common name. But my mom has her own special name! (pause) Now, special names! (pause) A special name is for ONE person. (pause) It starts with a big capital letter.
special-1: Lita. (pause) My mom’s name is Lita. (pause) Big letter L.
special-2: Rico. (pause) My dad’s name is Rico. (pause) Big letter R.
special-3: Hinhin. (pause) My sister’s name is Hinhin. (pause) Big letter H.
special-4: Gas. (pause) My brother’s name is Gas. (pause) Big letter G.
which-name: Let us check: common or special? (pause) Same person, two names! (pause) Listen and tap.
which-name-q1: Which one is a special name?
which-name-q1-yes: Yes! Hinhin is a special name. (pause) It starts with a big H.
which-name-q1-hint: A special name is for one person. It starts with a big letter.
which-name-q2: Which name starts with a big capital letter?
which-name-q2-yes: Yes! Rico starts with a big R.
which-name-q3: Which one is a common name, with a small letter?
which-name-q3-yes: Yes! Mom is a common name. (pause) Small letter m.
this-is: You know common and special names. Now build a sentence! (pause) Now show your family! (pause) Tap a naming word. (pause) Then say the sentence with me.
talk: You can say who is in your family. Now say a special name! (pause) Now tell me about your family. (pause) What is your mom’s special name? (pause) Say: My mom’s name is Lita. (pause) Use your mom’s name!
verse: Our family loves us and teaches us. The Bible tells us this too. (pause) Our Bible verse is, (pause) Train up a child in the way he should go. (pause) Our family teaches us the good way. (pause) We love and listen to them.
verse-verse: Train up a child in the way he should go. (pause) Proverbs twenty-two, verse six.
done: What a happy family day! (pause) Hooray! (pause) You named my whole family. (pause) You sang the family song. (pause) And you know special names start with big letters. (pause) Tomorrow we meet more family: uncles, aunts and cousins!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
fx-still-1: Good listening! Simon did not say it.
fx-oops-1: Oops! Simon did not say it. Stay still next time!
fx-doit-1: Simon said it! Let us do it!
